reference_stage.content_prompt: Create a neutral structural reference for a landscape editorial illustration. Show exactly one generic cartoon ox wearing a simple detective hat and holding one magnifying glass. The ox is closely inspecting one hanging blank identity badge that contains only one large question mark. The ox should look puzzled, because it is investigating its own unknown identity. Keep the relationship immediately readable and leave generous white space. No other characters and no readable words.
output_constraints: Landscape 3:2 composition with the ox, magnifying glass, and identity badge inside the central 80 percent mobile crop-safe area
Exactly one ox, one detective hat, one magnifying glass, one hanging identity badge, and one question mark
avoid: Logos, trademarks, watermarks, extra animals, people, fake interfaces, news-scene realism, laboratory branding, or readable words

preserve: Preserve exactly one ox wearing one detective hat, holding one magnifying glass, and inspecting one hanging blank identity badge with one question mark
Preserve the puzzled self-investigation relationship and generous empty space
output_constraints: Landscape 3:2 composition with all key elements inside the central 80 percent mobile crop-safe area
avoid: Polished technology-magazine composition, clean vector geometry, cinematic depth, or professional illustration finish
